occupations.cat: Food processing, wood working, garment and other craft and related trades workers

n.story:
Your role is shifting from a manual applicator to a high-tech environmental consultant. In the past, you spent hours manually calculating dosages and walking perimeters to spray chemicals. Now, AI-powered computer vision and sensor networks handle the 'search and destroy' aspect of the job. Drones and autonomous ground units perform the bulk of the repetitive spraying, while AI models predict pest outbreaks by analyzing local weather patterns and historical infestation data.

With the technical 'grunt work' automated, you focus on high-level Integrated Pest Management (IPM) strategy. You use AI to instantly cross-reference complex European and national pesticide legislations, ensuring every treatment plan is perfectly compliant and environmentally sustainable. Your value now lies in your ability to interpret AI-generated heat maps of pest activity and provide expert, empathetic consultation to clients who are dealing with the stress of an infestation.
n.adv: Focus on mastering Integrated Pest Management (IPM) principles and learn to use data visualization tools to explain infestation risks to your clients.

n.story:
Your daily work is evolving from manual labor to high-tech environmental management. While the physical nature of working outdoors remains, the way you interact with the land is being transformed by precision technology. Instead of broad-spectrum spraying, you will increasingly oversee autonomous drones and robotic systems that identify and target individual weeds or pests with surgical precision. This shift significantly reduces chemical waste and improves safety by keeping you at a distance from hazardous substances.

Your expertise will pivot toward being a 'phytosanitary consultant.' You will use AI to interpret complex European pesticide legislation and chemical interaction data, ensuring that every application is perfectly compliant and environmentally optimized. You are no longer just a sprayer; you are a guardian of crop health who uses data-driven insights to manage pest control operations with a level of efficiency and safety that manual methods could never achieve.
